# [Tutorial on using async / await in Rust](/t/tutorial-on-using-async-await-in-rust/76246)

Hi everyone. As I've been learning Rust recently I've been capturing knowledge in tutorials to help my future self ![:grinning:](https://emoji.discourse-cdn.com/twitter/grinning.png?v=12 ":grinning:"). So I'm sharing it here in the hopes that it will benefit others in the community.

![:grinning:](https://emoji.discourse-cdn.com/twitter/grinning.png?v=12 ":grinning:")
![](https://developerlife.com/favicon.svg)

### [Write code using async/await in Rust](https://developerlife.com/2022/03/12/rust-tokio/)

This article illustrates how to write concurrent and parallel code in Rust using Tokio. The pedagogical example we will use is building an asynchronous implementation of a middleware runner that you might find in a Redux store.

It covers async traits objects as well!

Enjoy!
